Rajasthan nuclear reactors begin initial fuel loading

The Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd (NPCIL) began the initial fuel loading for the 700 MWe Rajasthan Atomic Power Station units 7 and 8 at Rawatbhata on Saturday. This marks a significant milestone in India's nuclear power program and signifies the reactors entering a key commissioning stage.
